library(tidytext)
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
df<- data.frame(article = "Soc 128d",
                text = c("In this class, we learn about text mining",
                "Text minning is a great way",
                "Text mining is fun!"))
tidy_df<- df%>%
  unnest_tokens(word,text)

tidy_df %<>%
  anti_join(stop_words)

```{r sentiment}
#install.packages("textdata")
library(textdata)
library(tidytext)
library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
get_sentiments("nrc")


tidy_comments %<>%
  inner_join(get_sentiments("nrc"))
tidy_comments %>%
  select(word, sentiment)

table(tidy_comments$)

ggplot(tidy_comments, aes(y-sentiment))+
  geom_bar(aes(fill = sentiment))+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(title = "sentiment")

```
